name: Berimbolo
description: Mikey Musumeci’s The Berimbolo System Part 1: The Foundation covers double pull, De La Riva grips, inversion and berimbolo variations.
summary: Double-pull positioning, inversion and the basic berimbolo, with routes to the back and mount.
overview: The Berimbolo System Part 1: The Foundation introduces Mikey Musumeci’s approach through double-pull positioning, De La Riva grips and inversion. It then develops the basic berimbolo into stacking, pulling and uninverting options. This guide emphasizes the starting positions and foundations within that eight-volume release.

related_content.name: Mikey Musumeci Berimbolo System
related_content.relationship: The same foundation course viewed through its stacking, pulling and twister-hook variations; no additional course is required.

products.title: The Berimbolo System Part 1: The Foundation
products.blurb: An eight-volume foundation course covering berimbolo entries and subsequent positional options.
products.best_for: Guard players interested in the foundations of Musumeci’s berimbolo approach.

fits: You want a berimbolo course that includes the double-pull and grip-fighting context.
You are interested in inversion-based guard attacks toward the back or mount.
consider_alternative_if: You want guard offense that avoids inversion and double-pull situations.

includes: Double-pull positioning, De La Riva hand fighting and inversion.
Basic berimbolo entries with leg or hip grips.
Stacking, pulling and uninverting options leading toward back control or mount.
limits: This is Part 1: The Foundation, not the entire multi-release Berimbolo System. Collar and pant grips feature in its starting-position material.
